about.desc: The Palestine Math Olympiad is a national initiative dedicated to discovering, training, and empowering talented students in mathematics. Through a series of competitive stages, engaging workshops, and collaborative partnerships, we aim to strengthen mathematical excellence and inspire the next generation of problem-solvers and innovators across Palestine.

winterCamp.aboutDescription:
The Winter Training Camp for the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad was launched on Saturday, 10/1/2026, and continued for six days, hosted generously by Al-Istiqlal University in the city of Jericho, where the camp concluded successfully.

A total of 53 male and female students from 18 directorates participated in the camp. They were selected through a rigorous multi-stage selection process that began at the school level with the participation of more than 5,000 students. This was followed by 1,046 students advancing to the directorate level, then a pre-final stage that included 140 students, culminating in a final stage of 53 students representing 18 directorates.

The camp hosted international academics and supervisors specialized in international and Arab mathematics Olympiads, alongside local academics from several Palestinian universities, who dedicated their time and expertise to enhancing the students’ academic level during this stage.

The training team also included supervisors from various directorates of the Palestinian Ministry of Education and Higher Education, who contributed to the success of the camp and the achievement of its educational and academic objectives.
